nodes.name: org_actions.rs
nodes.summary: CRUD action handlers (list/get/create/update/remove) for AgentOrgsStore org definitions, invoked by the agent_def tool's action dispatch.

nodes.name: list_orgs
nodes.summary: Formats a human-readable summary of all defined agent organizations, or a hint message when none exist.

nodes.name: get_org
nodes.summary: Looks up and formats the detail view of a single org definition by id.

nodes.name: create_org
nodes.summary: Validates parameters and inserts a new OrgDefinition (with parsed sub-agent members) into the org store.

nodes.name: update_org
nodes.summary: Applies partial updates (name, members) to an existing org definition, re-parsing member lists as needed.

nodes.name: remove_org
nodes.summary: Deletes an org definition by id from the store, returning an error if it does not exist.

nodes.name: parsing.rs
nodes.summary: Parses and validates sub-agent and org-member definitions from tool parameters, including fuzzy name-similarity checks to catch near-duplicate member names.

nodes.name: parse_sub_agents
nodes.summary: Parses the sub_agents parameter array into validated org member structs.

nodes.name: parse_org_members
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that parses the org members list for org create/update actions.

nodes.name: parse_single_member
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a single member entry (name, role, model) from a JSON value, applying name-similarity checks.

nodes.name: schema.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the static JSON Schema describing the agent_def tool's parameters for org and sub-agent management actions.

nodes.name: parameters_schema
nodes.summary: Builds the static JSON Schema object describing all valid parameters/actions for the agent_def management tool.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel that declares and re-exports the send_message and send_to_inbox tool implementations under the comms namespace.

nodes.name: send_message.rs
nodes.summary: Implements MessageTool, an agent Tool that sends messages to chat channels via the AgentMessageBus, remembering a default channel/chat_id context.

nodes.name: MessageTool
nodes.summary: Tool implementation that sends a message to a chat channel through the AgentMessageBus, remembering the last-used channel/chat_id as session context.

nodes.name: llm_description
nodes.summary: Returns the LLM-facing description explaining when/how to use the send_message tool.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Declares the JSON Schema for the send_message tool's parameters (channel, chat_id, text).

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Executes the send_message tool: resolves the target channel/chat_id and publishes an OutboundMessage on the AgentMessageBus.

nodes.name: send_to_inbox.rs
nodes.summary: Implements InboxTool, an agent Tool that lets agents push notifications/summaries into the user's inbox via inbox::persistence.

nodes.name: InboxTool
nodes.summary: Tool implementation that writes agent-authored notifications/summaries into the user's inbox store.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Declares the JSON Schema for the send_to_inbox tool's parameters.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Executes the send_to_inbox tool: builds an InboxMessage and upserts it via inbox::persistence.

nodes.name: escape_hotkey.rs
nodes.summary: macOS system-wide Escape key observer (CGEventTap) that aborts in-flight desktop automation, with a self-suppression mechanism for Escape events synthesized by automation itself.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an unsafe CFRunLoop-based CGEventTap running on a dedicated thread for the app's lifetime, started lazily via an atomic guard.

nodes.name: ensure_started
nodes.summary: Lazily spawns the Escape-key CGEventTap monitor thread on first call; idempotent across repeated calls.

nodes.name: escape_tap_callback
nodes.summary: CGEventTap callback invoked on every keyboard event; detects real (non-synthetic) Escape keydowns, honors the expected-escape suppression counter, and triggers computer_use_lock::request_abort.

nodes.name: run_event_tap
nodes.summary: Sets up the CGEventTap, adds it to a dedicated thread's CFRunLoop, and runs the run loop for the lifetime of the process.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel aggregating desktop automation tool implementations: escape-hotkey monitor, Peekaboo CLI tool, permissions, and screen capture.

nodes.name: peekaboo_cli_tool.rs
nodes.summary: Implements PeekabooCliTool, a large agent Tool wrapping the bundled 'peekaboo' CLI sidecar for desktop automation (clicks, screenshots, window ops), including sidecar download/install, command allow-listing/timeouts, and window-visibility guarding during automation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Drop-based RAII guard (DesktopOperationVisibilityGuard) with a reference-counted generation to restore window visibility even on panics or early returns.

nodes.name: PeekabooCliTool
nodes.summary: Agent Tool that proxies desktop-automation commands (click, screenshot, type, etc.) to the bundled Peekaboo CLI sidecar process, applying an allow-list, timeouts, and visibility guarding.

nodes.name: DesktopOperationVisibilityGuard
nodes.summary: RAII guard that hides/restores the app's main window and Wingman bar around a desktop-automation operation, using a reference count and generation counter to safely handle overlapping or aborted operations.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Entry point for the peekaboo tool: validates the requested command against the allow-list and dispatches it to the CLI sidecar.

nodes.name: run_peekaboo_cli_command
nodes.summary: Spawns the peekaboo sidecar process with managed arguments and a command-specific timeout, capturing stdout/stderr and killing the process group on timeout.

nodes.name: install_peekaboo_sidecar
nodes.summary: Downloads and extracts the versioned Peekaboo CLI release archive into the app's sidecar directory and marks the binary executable.

nodes.name: download_to
nodes.summary: Streams an HTTP download to a destination file path using the configured HTTP client.

nodes.name: apply_desktop_operation_visibility
nodes.summary: Applies the configured hide-main-window behavior at the start of a desktop automation operation, recording prior visibility state.

nodes.name: restore_desktop_operation_visibility_if_idle
nodes.summary: Restores window visibility after a delay only if no other desktop operation has started in the meantime, checked via the generation counter.

nodes.name: restore_desktop_operation_visibility_now
nodes.summary: Immediately restores the main window and Wingman bar visibility to their pre-operation state.

nodes.name: restore_desktop_operation_visibility_snapshot
nodes.summary: Restores window visibility from a previously captured snapshot, used by the visibility-test helper.

nodes.name: show_desktop_operation_visibility_test
nodes.summary: Test/debug entry point that exercises the visibility hide-and-restore cycle without running a real Peekaboo command.

nodes.name: ensure_allowed_peekaboo_command
nodes.summary: Validates that the requested Peekaboo subcommand is present in the allow-list before it is passed to the sidecar process.

nodes.name: resolve_peekaboo_executable
nodes.summary: Resolves the filesystem path to the Peekaboo sidecar executable, installing it on demand if missing.

nodes.name: format_peekaboo_output
nodes.summary: Formats the sidecar's raw stdout/stderr/status into the tool-result string returned to the agent.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: DesktopOperationVisibilityGuard constructor: captures and optionally hides the current window state for the duration of an operation.

nodes.name: drop
nodes.summary: Drop impl that decrements the visibility reference count and schedules/performs window-visibility restoration when the last guard is released.

nodes.name: permissions.rs
nodes.summary: Checks and requests macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions required for desktop automation, exposing a DesktopPermissions status struct.

nodes.name: check_permissions
nodes.summary: Queries macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording authorization status and returns a DesktopPermissions summary.

nodes.name: request_accessibility
nodes.summary: Prompts the user for Accessibility permission via the macOS system dialog.

nodes.name: dict_helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Low-level helpers for reading typed values (i32, String, CGRect, f64) out of macOS CFDictionary-style dictionaries used by screen-capture APIs.

nodes.name: dict_get_rect
nodes.summary: Reads a CGRect (x/y/width/height) out of a CFDictionary-style value, returning None if any component is missing or malformed.

nodes.name: displays.rs
nodes.summary: Enumerates connected displays and their geometry/scale factor via macOS CoreGraphics APIs, and resolves which display contains a given point.

nodes.name: list_displays
nodes.summary: Enumerates all active displays via CoreGraphics, returning geometry, pixel size, and scale factor for each.

nodes.name: display_for_point
nodes.summary: Finds which enumerated display's bounds contain a given global screen point.

nodes.name: jpeg.rs
nodes.summary: Captures full-display or region screenshots and encodes them as JPEG (with optional downscaling), used by desktop automation tools to produce compact visual context for the agent.

nodes.name: capture_display_jpeg_sized
nodes.summary: Captures a full display as JPEG, optionally downscaling to a maximum dimension before encoding.

nodes.name: capture_region_jpeg_sized
nodes.summary: Captures a rectangular region (in global screen coordinates, resolved to the owning display) as JPEG.

nodes.name: capture_display_local_region_jpeg
nodes.summary: Captures a region specified in a display's local coordinate space as JPEG.

nodes.name: capture_region_global_jpeg
nodes.summary: Captures a region specified in global screen coordinates as JPEG, mapping it onto the correct display first.

nodes.name: maybe_downscale
nodes.summary: Downscales a captured CGImage to fit within a maximum dimension while preserving aspect ratio, used to keep screenshots small for the LLM.

nodes.name: cgimage_to_jpeg
nodes.summary: Encodes a CGImage into JPEG bytes at the requested quality using macOS ImageIO.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel re-exporting the screen-capture submodules (dict helpers, displays, jpeg, png, windows) used by the desktop automation tools.

nodes.name: png.rs
nodes.summary: Captures window/screen/display screenshots and encodes them as base64 PNG, including a CGWindowListCreateImage-based fallback path for window capture.

nodes.name: capture_display_png
nodes.summary: Captures a full display as a CGImage and encodes it to PNG bytes.

nodes.name: capture_via_cg_window_list
nodes.summary: Fallback window-capture path using CGWindowListCreateImage, used when the primary capture API is unavailable for a given window.

nodes.name: cgimage_to_png
nodes.summary: Encodes a CGImage into PNG bytes using macOS ImageIO.
